text.description_html:
Fist Impressions 10" Gothic Cross Door Pull

The Gothic Cross Door Pull has a 10 inch diameter. It is made for a set of double doors where one half of the pull mounts on the right side and the other half mounts on the left side. This custom made door pull is fashioned out of brass and has a beautiful satin nickel finish. It is Thrubolted Mounted, meaning that the pull bolts through the door and the screws are visible on the inside of the door.

Specifications of the Celtic Cross Door Pull:

  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Material: 3/8" thick Brass
  • Overall Length: 10"
  • Total Width (both sections combined): 10"
  • Width of One Half: 5"
  • 3 Standoffs with center to center lengths 4.375" between each standoff.
  • Standoff Projection: 1.5"
  • Standoff Diameter: 1/2"

Note: This decorative door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts through the door).

Sold Individually
